aire x von dutch disgraced washed green.description: Provided in a muted green tone that looks like it's been washed for a vintage aesthetic, AIRE and Von Dutch welcome the collaborative Disgraced sunglasses for an oversized, stylish look. Using a boxy shape, the impact-resistant frame employs gold-tinted scratch-resistant polycarbonate lenses that provide category 1 UV protection to handle any sunny day.

ajmal aristocrat — eau de parfum en spra.name: Ajmal Aristocrat — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para mujer
ajmal aristocrat — eau de parfum en spra.description: First released in 2018, Ajmal Aristocrat for her is a sophisticated floral woody musk that interfuses tones of citrus, white florals and sheer musk. Sparkling, tart-sweet orange and bergamot open the scent, harmonized with earthy, honeyed marigold nuances. Subtly intoxicating jasmine and warm hints of saffron emerge at the heart, sweetened with a touch of sugar.

ajmal evoke gold — eau de parfum en spra.name: Ajmal Evoke Gold — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para mujer
ajmal evoke gold — eau de parfum en spra.description: Released by Ajmal in 2018, Evoke Gold is a bold yet feminine fragrance for women with a sense of adventure. A sweet and spicy blend of black currant, pink pepper and apple top notes open the fragrance, pulling you in with its unique scent. Floral heart notes of lily of the valley and peony soften the perfume and lead the way into warm, rich base notes of musk, tonka bean and vanilla that finish the fragrance with a hint of sweetness.
